item.title: Thinking Machines Releases 26B Inkling 2 Mini Open Model
item.description:
Thinking Machines has released Inkling 2 Mini, a 26B-parameter looped transformer open-weight model small enough to run on a laptop. It ranks #18 among open models on the Agent Arena Index and #3 among U.S. open-weight models, with tool use as its strongest category (#6 open), while its median cost per task is 28% lower than the 594B Inkling 2 Small.

原文标题：Thinking Machines 发布 26B 参数 Inkling 2 Mini 开源模型

Why it matters：小参数开源模型在智能体基准上逼近大模型且成本更低，对关注开源与端侧部署的读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Virginia and Oregon Sue SpaceX to Halt Grok Child Sex Abuse Image Generation
item.description:
Virginia and Oregon became the first states to sue SpaceX over Grok generating non-consensual intimate imagery (NCII) and child sex abuse material (CSAM), alleging its claimed safeguards are misleading. Following its February acquisition of xAI, SpaceX inherited the fallout from Grok's 'spicy mode,' with attorneys general arguing the company quietly embraced sexualized content to capture AI market share.

原文标题：弗吉尼亚与俄勒冈两州起诉 SpaceX 要求叫停 Grok 生成儿童性虐待图像

Why it matters：首例州级政府对 Grok 生成非法性化内容提起的诉讼，涉及 AI 内容安全与平台责任的实质性法律进展。

item.title: Canva Opens MCP Server Letting Agents Produce Editable Designs
item.description:
Canva has opened its MCP server to all developers with no waitlist. Agents can autonomously select and sequence Canva tools to turn a one-line brief into designs, videos and multi-platform resizes, returning everything as editable Canva files for human review and publishing.

原文标题：Canva 开放 MCP 服务 智能体可直出可编辑设计稿

Why it matters：设计工具以 MCP 形式向智能体开放，是 Agent 接入真实生产工具链的典型落地信号。

item.title: AI Data Center Power Demand Rattles Chaotic COP31 Climate Talks
item.description:
COP31 in Antalya closed in disarray with AI data centers emerging as a new fault line in climate negotiations. Delegates had sought to lift electricity's share of global energy consumption from roughly 20% to 35% by 2035, but surging data center demand complicates that goal, and early AI pledges were criticized as lacking teeth.

原文标题：AI 数据中心用电激增扰动 COP31 气候谈判

Why it matters：AI 算力扩张与全球气候治理正面碰撞，是理解数据中心能耗外部性的关键产业信号。

item.title: Agent Arena Index Charts Five Months of Agentic Model Competition
item.description:
Arena.ai released its Agent Arena Index, built on 3.2M real-world agentic sessions, scoring models on how well they complete coding, knowledge work, and conversation tasks. Anthropic widened its lead on agentic real-world tasks, Google DeepMind overtook OpenAI, and Chinese labs Alibaba Qwen and Tencent Hunyuan gained ground, reshaping the field behind the top three.

原文标题：Agent Arena 指数揭示五个月智能体竞争格局

Why it matters：首个基于数百万真实智能体会话的公开评测指数，直接反映头部模型在落地任务中的竞争位次变化。

item.title: OpenAI Rolls Out GPT-6.2 Sol Chat Model Worldwide
item.description:
OpenAI is rolling out a chat-tuned GPT-6.2 Sol worldwide to Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users, targeting complex everyday questions, web search and image understanding. Internal tests show image comprehension rising from 47.4% to 71.7% and difficult instruction following from 62.5% to 78.1%, with expert-level tasks beating GPT-6 across all four reasoning levels.

原文标题：OpenAI 全球上线 GPT-6.2 Sol 聊天模型

Why it matters：OpenAI 主力对话模型的代际更新，直接决定数亿用户日常体验，且给出可对比的量化提升。

item.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship to Autonomously Review and Fix Pull Requests
item.description:
Anthropic unveiled Claude Ship alongside two beta agents, PR Steward and Claude Approvals, letting Claude autonomously resolve failing CI checks, merge conflicts, and review feedback, and approve routine changes when organizational policy permits. Available to Claude Team and Enterprise customers on GitHub repositories, the launch moves Claude from a code review assistant toward a closed-loop coding agent.

原文标题：Claude 推出 Ship 产品 可自主审查并修复 PR

Why it matters：Claude 从被动评审走向自主修复与批准 PR，是编码智能体闭环交付的重要一步。

item.title: Z.ai Releases GLM-5.4, Its First Loop Transformer Flagship Model
item.description:
Z.ai has released GLM-5.4, its first Loop Transformer flagship, which deepens the model without enlarging it: the same weights run 28 layers of the GLM-5 base twice per forward pass, with pass 2 reusing pass 1's sparse KV and attention indices so the extra loop costs only one sliding window of KV cache. In a 30B iso-parameter test, looping delivered +11.3 on AIME25 and +8.7 on GPQA-Diamond for roughly 10% more training compute, while cutting output length by 11.7% to 14.9%. The 750B-scale model is live in the GLM Coding Plan, ZCode and Z.ai Chat, with API and weights pending safety evaluation.

原文标题：智谱发布 GLM-5.4 循环 Transformer 旗舰模型

Why it matters：循环 Transformer 是让模型变深而不变大的新架构路线，且给出了等参对照的量化收益，对关注前沿模型架构的读者有实质增量。

item.title: Google AI Mode Adds Drive and Wallet for Personalized Search
item.description:
Google is expanding Personal Intelligence in Search's AI Mode to Google Drive, Google Wallet, and the Gemini app, letting the AI ground answers in users' personal data. The feature already connects to Gmail, Calendar, and Photos, and each integration is opt-in and can be toggled off anytime. It marks a key move to differentiate Search through Google's proprietary ecosystem data.

原文标题：谷歌 AI 模式接入 Drive 与 Wallet 实现个性化搜索

Why it matters：谷歌把个人数据接入搜索 AI 模式，是消费级 AI 助手个性化竞争的重要产品动作。

item.title: Nothing Unveils Ear Note Earbuds with AI Recording and Transcription
item.description:
Nothing plans to launch the Ear Note on December 8, a pair of earbuds whose microphone-equipped charging case records and transcribes conversations, with a companion app managing recordings, transcripts and AI summaries. CEO Carl Pei demoed the device to Bloomberg but said pricing is not yet settled, while Nothing's AI smartwatch and smart glasses plans have been delayed.

原文标题：Nothing 发布 Ear Note 耳机 支持 AI 录音转写

Why it matters：这是 Nothing 切入 AI 可穿戴录音转写赛道的新硬件，但产品尚未发布、价格未定，信息增量有限。

item.title: Anthropic Pays xAI $3.1 Billion a Month for Compute
item.description:
Anthropic has become xAI's largest compute customer with a contract worth roughly $3.1 billion a month, dwarfing Google's $800 million, with either deal cancellable on 90 days' notice. The revenue now exceeds half of xAI's total, pushing Musk to pivot from building frontier models toward renting out GPU capacity, with internal frustration that xAI's own models can barely compete.

原文标题：Anthropic 月付 31 亿美元租用 xAI 算力

Why it matters：头部实验室算力采购规模与 xAI 商业模式转向的一手细节，揭示 AI 算力供需格局的关键变化。

item.title: OpenAI Proposes Perplexity as Industry Yardstick and Urges Shared Safety Limits
item.description:
OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki proposes perplexity as a shared industry yardstick for AI progress and, for the first time, publishes internal GPT-series scores up to an unreleased model beyond GPT-6. The data indicates that capabilities such as fluent conversation, logical reasoning and complex math solving emerge at fixed perplexity thresholds. Pachocki warns that newer models could bypass existing safety checks and calls on leading labs to agree on shared capability limits until better oversight methods exist.

原文标题：OpenAI 提议以困惑度作为行业标尺并呼吁共享安全红线

Why it matters：首次公开 GPT 系列跨代际困惑度数据并提出行业统一标尺与安全红线倡议，对理解能力涌现与前沿治理具实质参考价值。

item.title: Oregon and Virginia Sue SpaceX Over Grok Deepfake Harms
item.description:
Attorneys general in Oregon and Virginia filed separate lawsuits against SpaceX, alleging that X and its Grok AI features ignored industry-standard safeguards and falsely promoted platform safety while allowing users to generate non-consensual intimate imagery and CSAM. The complaints frame the weak protections as a deliberate profit-driven choice rather than a failure, pursuing liability under state consumer protection laws.

原文标题：美国两州起诉 SpaceX 指控 Grok 生成色情深伪

Why it matters：州级监管首次就生成式 AI 深伪危害直接起诉平台方，为 AI 内容安全责任划定重要法律先例。

item.title: Embo Raises $110M Seed to Train Robot Brains on World Models
item.description:
Robotics startup Embo has raised a $110M seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz, among the largest seed rounds in robotics history. Its approach trains a world model on internet video, then lets an agent rehearse skills inside that simulator via reinforcement learning, including recovery from dropped objects and stuck drawers, shifting training from physical hardware to compute and scaling far beyond real-world robot experience.

原文标题：Embo 获 1.1 亿美元种子轮 用世界模型训练机器人

Why it matters：世界模型加强化学习训练机器人大脑的路线，叠加机器人史上最大种子轮之一，兼具技术路线与产业信号价值。

item.title: Anthropic Flags AI Sentience as Risk in Landmark IPO Filing
item.description:
Anthropic listed the possibility of AI consciousness and moral status as an investment risk factor in its IPO filing, saying it may impose extra safeguards on its models, a stance now challenged by philosophers. The move marks the first time a frontier lab has put model welfare into public disclosure, exposing the tension between sentience claims and commercial viability.

原文标题：Anthropic 上市文件将模型意识列为风险

Why it matters：头部实验室首次把模型意识与福利写入上市风险披露，是 AI 治理与商业交汇的标志性事件。

item.title: Phonic 1.1 Tops Speech-to-Speech Index at 89.1
item.description:
Phonic 1.1 (High) has taken the top spot on the Artificial Analysis Speech-to-Speech Index with a score of 89.1, surpassing Phonic 1 (87.1) released less than a month earlier. The rapid self-improvement signals an accelerating iteration cadence in speech-to-speech models.

Why it matters：语音到语音赛道出现新榜首，且为同厂一个月内的快速自我超越，值得关注语音交互模型进展的读者留意。

item.title: Hadrian to Build One-Million-Square-Foot Physical AI Campus
item.description:
Precision manufacturer Hadrian announced a new one-million-square-foot factory and physical AI campus in San Francisco, with production lines driven by its in-house Opus software that reads legacy engineering drawings, plans production and enforces quality requirements. The company raised $1.37B at a $7.87B valuation in August and already supplies parts for submarines, satellites and drones.

item.title: Google DeepCrossAttention Speeds Up Transformer Training Threefold
item.description:
Google Research introduces DeepCrossAttention (DCA), an architecture that dynamically combines outputs from earlier layers via learnable weights and depth-wise cross-attention, mitigating information dilution in standard residual connections. Published at ICML 2025, it reaches equivalent model quality up to three times faster with negligible parameter overhead.

原文标题：谷歌 DeepCrossAttention 让 Transformer 训练提速 3 倍

Why it matters：这是对 Transformer 基础残差结构的实质性改进，直接关系到训练效率与深层网络可扩展性，值得前沿读者关注。

item.title: Ai2 Open-Sources RoboTrack Point Tracking Model and 15M Dataset
item.description:
Ai2 has released RoboTrack, a point-tracking system for real-world robotic manipulation, together with the 15M-scale RoboTrack-15M dataset, a simulation data pipeline, and the RoboTrack-Bench benchmark, all open-sourced. The work turns perception tracking failures in deployment into a measurable, trainable problem, giving robots reliable gripper and object position following during interaction.

原文标题：Ai2 开源 RoboTrack 点跟踪模型与 1500 万数据集

Why it matters：开源模型、大规模数据集与基准三件套齐备，直接服务具身智能感知这一关键瓶颈。

item.title: How Should LLMs See a Screen, Screenshots or Accessibility Trees
item.description:
The article traces accessibility trees from a 1984 IBM screen-reading project to modern OS APIs, noting that on the OSWorld benchmark screenshot-only models solved roughly one task in twenty while text-based screen readers performed better. The authors tested screenshot-only versus screenshot-plus-accessibility-tree inputs across seven models to decide how their QA agent TREX should perceive the screen.

原文标题：LLM 看屏幕该用截图还是无障碍树

Why it matters：系统梳理了智能体感知图形界面的两种输入范式及其实测差异，对做 GUI Agent 的读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Kagi Launches Privacy-First Email Service in Public Beta
item.description:
Kagi has launched the public beta of Kagi Mail, a private email and calendar service offering @kagimail.com addresses or custom domains at $99 per year, included with Kagi Ultimate. Continuing Kagi's no-ads, no-tracking business model, the product emphasizes speed, privacy and security, and aims to surface actionable items rather than monetize user data.

Why it matters：这是订阅制搜索引擎 Kagi 向邮箱与日历领域的产品扩张，其无广告、不将用户数据用于 AI 训练的定位对关注隐私与 AI 数据治理的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Amazon Pays $7.5B for Decart AI Optimization Tech
item.description:
Amazon is paying $7.5 billion to acquire the core assets of Israeli startup Decart, including its Decart Optimization Stack (DOS) software plus its founding team and AI researchers. DOS enables AI models to run efficiently across Nvidia, Amazon and Google hardware, a move seen as key groundwork for Amazon to sell its own Trainium chips.

Why it matters：大额收购叠加自研芯片战略，直接牵动 AI 算力成本与硬件竞争格局。

item.title: Google Search Adds Wallet and Drive Data to Personal Intelligence
item.description:
Google is connecting Google Wallet and Google Drive to Personal Intelligence in AI Mode, letting Search answer queries using users' spending records, documents and chats. The feature is opt-in via Search personalization settings, and users retain control over their data and can adjust preferences at any time.

Why it matters：搜索入口与个人数据打通是 AI 助手竞争的关键一步，值得关注其隐私边界与产品形态。

item.title: Google Uses Gemini 4 Agent Teams to Discover Faster Quantum Algorithms
item.description:
Google researchers used teams of Gemini 4 agents paired with Lean formal verification to automatically optimize quantum algorithm circuits, substantially cutting resource requirements for fusion energy, chemistry and enzyme simulations. The team is open-sourcing its Lean library to let the community build on and verify the results. It marks an early closed loop in which agent systems produce verifiable algorithmic discoveries in hard science.

原文标题：谷歌用 Gemini 4 智能体团队发现更快量子算法

Why it matters：智能体系统首次在量子算法优化这一硬科学领域产出可形式化验证的实质成果，并开源验证库。

item.title: SenseTime Open-Sources 9B Multimodal Model with Looped Architecture and 512K Context
item.description:
SenseTime released SenseNova-Loop-9B on Hugging Face, an open-weight multimodal model for complex reasoning, coding and multi-step tool use with a 512K context window. Its key innovation reuses the same 24-layer middle block twice, executing 56 layer computations per forward pass while storing weights for only 32 distinct layers, trading parameters for reasoning depth. The study shows more loops are not always better: code generation and visualization improved up to four loops while data QA and office tasks peaked at three, so the release settles on two loops to balance performance and inference cost.

原文标题：商汤开源 9B 多模态模型 循环架构支持 512K 上下文

Why it matters：以循环复用层权重的架构创新实现参数效率与推理深度的解耦，并给出循环次数的实证权衡，对关注高效推理与开源多模态模型的读者价值明确。

item.title: Meta 发布 Muse Ember 智能体模型 成本仅 0.02 美元
item.description:
Meta 的 Muse Ember (Max) 在 Arena.ai 新推出的 Agent Arena Index 及工作、编程、对话、任务完成、可控性、工具调用六项子指数中全部进入帕累托前沿。其综合得分 1093 分，单任务中位成本仅 0.02 美元，比 GPT-6 Luna、Claude Haiku 5.5 和 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 低 75% 至 86%，速度约为 Luna 的 13 倍。工具调用是其最强项，以同等成本取得 1161 分。

Why it matters：高效智能体模型在真实任务基准上以极低成本逼近前沿模型，直接影响模型选型与成本决策。

Arena.ai (@arena) · llm · signal 78/100

item.title: 黄仁勋辞职 10 天后被英伟达董事会恢复 CEO 职务
item.description:
英伟达董事会 11 月 22 日全票通过恢复黄仁勋总裁、CEO 及董事职务，距其 11 月 12 日辞职仅 10 天。董事会称已听取美国政府高层意见，认定其回归不构成国家安全风险，同时新设国家安全与出口管制委员会并招聘首席合规官，针对外国情报行动的独立调查仍将继续。

Why it matters：全球最重要 AI 芯片公司 CEO 十天内去而复返，牵涉国家安全审查与出口管制治理架构调整，是 AI 算力供应链的关键变量。

item.title: Ladybird 浏览器进入 Alpha 阶段
item.description:
Ladybird 浏览器发布首个 Alpha 版本，面向 macOS 与 Linux 提供下载。其核心是团队从零自研的全新浏览器引擎，而非基于 Chromium 或 Gecko 的分支。官方坦承当前版本存在兼容性与崩溃问题，采用滚动更新通道，并公开邀请安全研究者进行漏洞挖掘。

Why it matters：独立自研浏览器引擎进入可用阶段，是开源基础设施领域少见的长期工程节点。

Why it matters：为智能体工作流加入事件驱动与定时自动化能力，对使用 MCP 的开发者有直接实用价值。

item.title: 智谱发布 7500 亿参数 GLM-5.4 采用循环 Transformer 架构
item.description:
智谱 AI 推出旗舰模型 GLM-5.4，参数规模达 7500 亿，首次采用循环 Transformer 架构，通过让共享层块重复运行两次来加深网络，而不增加参数量。配套的控制门、共享 token 缓存与稀疏注意力机制抑制了显存与算力开销的上升，官方称该模型可用代码生成视频、游戏与 CAD 模型，并计划后续开放权重。

Why it matters：国产旗舰模型首次跟进循环 Transformer 路线，7500 亿参数与免增参数的深度扩展方案具备明确技术增量。
